answer.answer: No – these are not independent confirmations: the shared Australia/NZ tows have identical dates and nearly identical (slightly jittered) coordinates in both NCEI records, indicating Eriksen et al. 2014 re-entered/recompiled the same underlying Reisser et al. 2013 cruise samples rather than collecting new ones. For the matched samples the Reisser/Eriksen concentration ratio has a median of about 1.13, but with very large scatter (roughly 0.27–3.8), reflecting reprocessing differences rather than true independent agreement.
